evidence_loop.label: fifty-five capabilities Claude registered twice, moved where only Codex resolves them
evidence_loop.summary:
Claude Code registered every packaged capability twice, once as its slash command and once as the SKILL.md it finds at the conventional plugins/

/skills/ path, so six plugins cost 112 registrations and about 15,431 always-on tokens per session on 2.1.276. The relocation moved the 55 SKILL.md files to plugins/

/core/skills/ and pointed only each Codex manifest at that root, one package per release across six releases, after a preparation PR made the shared gates manifest-resolved and added a guard against rediscovery through a restored copy or a symlink. Installed from the releases, Claude registers 57 components, exactly the 57 command files, for about 3,311 always-on tokens on 2.1.280; Codex 0.156.1 resolves all 55 skills from core/skills with no load errors, and a live mention injects the relocated file. The doctor proof reads the same blocked 87% as the preceding loop, on the same compatibility criterion.

feature_commits.note: S0: every cross-package gate resolves each plugin's skills root from its Codex manifest, a no-rediscovery guard rejects a SKILL.md or symlink left at the conventional path of a relocated plugin (fixture-tested while still vacuous), and ADR-0006 is amended in place. Moves nothing.
S1 canary: plugins/image skills to core/skills and its Codex manifest root to ./core/skills/, leaving a README tombstone. A relocated copy measured Skills 12 to 6, the survivors its commands.
S2: plugins/engineer, 17 outbound relative references re-pointed; the decide registry must resolve nine-axis with 9 axes and no registry: diagnostic, mutation-verified.
S3: plugins/designer, 20 outbound references; registry asserted by the absence of the registry: diagnostic plus the file-only clarity preset, because its in-code fallback mirrors the default.
S4: plugins/founder, 16 outbound references; registry asserted by the absence of the registry: diagnostic plus the file-only compact preset, for the same vacuity reason as S3.
S5: plugins/orchestrator, no outbound references to re-point. audit is a command with no skill of its own and is in the post-move list, so the survivors are the commands.

S6: plugins/runtime. Commands and skills share all eleven names, so two fixtures settled which survived (commands/ removed reads 0, core/skills/ removed reads 11). Also re-points citations in the protected host-parity-baseline.md, so the release discharged an obligation.

hardening_commits.note: Pins the S0 mutation spec's baseline to a commit main keeps: the squash merge had left the pinned commit reachable only from the merged branch, so deleting that branch would have removed six of the seventeen controls.
Re-points three shipped engineer references at the relocated root; released as engineer 0.21.10.
Re-points one orchestrator prose reference at engineer's relocated root; released as orchestrator 0.13.6, before orchestrator's own move.

docs-typed: re-points two paths in an attention sensor comment and corrects a kit/lint claim in the designer tombstone. Routes no release, so Codex, which serves main, and Claude hold different bytes under designer 0.3.8 and attention 0.9.0.

install_method: No install command ran in this loop. Claude: plugin auto-update, triggered by this loop's first `claude plugin list --json` probe (which still printed 0.97.3), moved runtime to 0.97.4 at 2026-09-23T05:40:38Z, gitCommitSha df3763f; the other five were already current. Codex: served tree refreshed at 05:34:58Z by no command of this loop. No settings plugin-management artifact backs either.
narrative:
**Only a release could show the effect, so it was measured on the installed hosts, with controls.** `claude plugin details` reports designer 10, engineer 11, founder 10, image 6, orchestrator 9 and runtime 11: 57, and each list equals the plugin's command files by name. The counts alone cannot tell commands from skills where the two numbers are equal, so two discriminators were used: engineer and orchestrator register 11 and 9, their command counts, not their 10 and 8 skills, and on-invoke cost tracks command-file bytes (coefficient of variation 0.096) rather than SKILL.md bytes (0.602). The token figure also carries the 2.1.276 to 2.1.280 host change.

**Codex was re-specified from listing to resolving.** No packaged skill is in the model-visible list, by design: every one opts out through `policy.allow_implicit_invocation`, and real sessions on 2026-09-10 and 2026-09-14 showed that list at one packaged skill and then zero, before any move. Codex's own app-server `skills/list` with forceReload resolves all 55, each under `<plugin>/<released version>/core/skills/`, with zero errors, and a live `$engineer:frame` session's rollout records the relocated file's path and body while a `$engineer:nonexistent` control injects nothing. `codex debug prompt-input` was ruled out as an instrument: it renders no mention even for a system skill.

**Resolution was checked everywhere a runbook or registry reads.** All 118 concrete `$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT` references in the 57 installed commands (60 distinct paths) resolve; the same scan finds 10 and 6 missing when pre-move engineer 0.21.8 and image 0.3.0 commands are resolved against the new roots. All three personas resolve a file-only preset on both hosts with no `registry:` line, and a copy without the registry file degrades each to its in-code default. On Claude one command ran end to end: this loop's own /orchestrator:next dispatched S7 into /engineer:compose, whose runbook read the relocated compose skill from the installed engineer 0.21.10. The macro window carries exactly 55 SKILL.md renames and no skill added or deleted.

**Delivery is byte-identical where the version says it should be, and not where a docs commit intervened.** Under the scorecard digest recipe, re-verified against the 0.97.3 and 0.97.2 caches, image, engineer, founder, orchestrator and runtime are identical across Claude's cache, Codex's cache and the release tag. designer and attention differ on Codex by 3707f5c alone, because a docs-typed commit routes no release while Codex serves main.

**The parity reading is not this loop's effect.** The one blocked criterion is the same compat artifact that blocked the preceding proof. The baseline hash moved because S6 re-pointed the protected document's references to moved paths in three table rows, not because it was re-observed. The owner re-reviewed Codex /hooks, and this loop recorded settings-20260923T055128Z-284df5, binding codex 0.156.1 and the four bumped hook-bearing packages; either move alone stales an attestation, and no Codex hook file changed.

**One reading differs from the preceding proof for a reason outside the relocation.** `codex_resolved` reads decision installed, source list for all eight plugins: this run's `codex plugin list` probe succeeded, where the preceding one timed out and fell back to the cache. Follow-up R13 is answered for codex-cli 0.156.1 at the scope measured: all 55 packaged skills resolve under the replaced loader and one was invoked end to end. No pause criterion fired; the criteria and each package's last-known-good release are in the ADR-0006 2026-09-18 Amendment.

relations.note: The preceding runtime loop, and this loop's control: its proof, taken before any of these six releases, read the same blocked 87% on the same compatibility criterion, which is how that reading is attributed away from this loop.
